At a glance

Are you a self-employed worker or business owner who is unable to provide standard proof of income?

Our mortgage for self-employed workers is designed with you in mind, so you can finance or refinance your dream home.

Perfect if you are looking to:

  • Put as little as 10% down1
  • Refinance your mortgage for up to 80%1 of the value of your property
  • Take out a mortgage loan with a fixed or variable rate
  • Withdraw up to $60,000 from an RRSP to make a down payment under the Home Buyers' Plan (HBP)
  • Withdraw from your FHSA (Tax-free first home savings account) to finance your first home

2 key eligibility criteria

What type of property can you buy?

Properties are eligible if they have no more than two dwellings, one of which must be owner-occupied. The property value can be no more than $1,500,000. The loan limit is $750,000 in the Calgary, Vancouver, and Toronto metropolitan areas, and $600,000 in other regions.

Are you eligible?

You must have been a self-employed worker or small business owner for at least two years, and show two years' worth of sound financial and credit management.
